description: This file contains an extension on ChannelsStore that implements configuration loading, saving, and updating logic, including network requests through GatewayConnection, and utility functions for manipulating configuration data structures.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration schema from the server and updates local state with the received schema and UI hints.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current configuration snapshot from the server, updates local configuration states, and applies UI configuration.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Applies user interface related configuration, specifically setting the seam color in shared application state.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Returns the configuration schema node for a specific channel ID, if available.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value at a given path, with fallback logic for channel configurations.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Updates a configuration value at a specified path within the draft configuration and marks the draft as dirty.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft configuration asynchronously and reloads the latest configuration.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the configuration from the server.
